reviews.title: Great coverage BUT the process to remove it was horrible
reviews.body: It lasted a very long time, was easy to apply and didn’t move once it fully dried (about an hour for it to dry completely) it is very oily and wasn’t sticking so I had to use a Q-Tip to apply it because it wasn’t staying just by rubbing it on my hair. Trying to wash it out was a nightmare itself. I washed my hair multiple times and still felt the oils left in my hair. I used dawn dish soap, baby soap, makeup remover cream, purifying shampoo and nothing worked. I washed my hair 6X the first time trying to get it out and it didn’t work. The next day another 5X with everything listed above and still felt it in my hair.Recommend ONLY using it for your body as it comes off a lot easier than your hair. The color was very vibrant and the size of it was perfect for what I paid for. A little goes a long way the only downfall of the product is washing it out of your hair. Besides that it was perfect for what I needed to use it for!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 24, 2025
